title: Cozy Tennessee Country Retreat on 5 Acres!
description:
This Pegram vacation rental makes for the perfect countryside escape with all the amenities of the city still within reach! Enjoy the lush and peaceful grounds surrounding this home while you warm up beside the fire pit — you may even spot wildlife roaming around! Inside, unpack in the 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom space and enjoy a cup of coffee in the full kitchen. Meanwhile, sports and entertainment await in Downtown Nashville. Head to Harpeth River State Park for some outdoor adventure!

The space
STR 2022065555 | Family Friendly | 14’ x 20’ Covered Patio | ~14 Mi to Nashville

Bedroom: Queen Bed | Living Room: Sleeper Sofa | Additional Sleeping: Pack ‘n Play

INDOOR LIVING: Smart TV, dining table, DVD player, video library, board games, books
OUTDOOR LIVING: Spacious yard area, patio furniture, gas fire pit, gas grill, wooded views, wildlife viewing
KITCHEN: Dishwasher, refrigerator, stove/oven, microwave, Keurig coffee maker, coffee & tea, toaster, Crockpot, cooking basics, dishware & flatware, high chair, trash bags & paper towels
GENERAL: Free WiFi (40 Mbps), complimentary toiletries, hair dryer, towels/linens, central heating & A/C, keyless entry
FAQ: Step-free access, homeowner on-site (main house), quiet hours (10:00 PM-7:00 AM), 1 external security camera (facing driveway)
PARKING: Guest driveway (2 vehicles)
